CHAPTER 4 · ITEM 10 / 10

Equilibrium and changing markets

Diagnosing observed changes從結果推斷衝擊

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Work backward from observed changes in price and quantity to determine which proposed demand or supply shift could explain them; identify when more than one explanation is possible.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

價量同升可由需求增加解釋；價升量跌可由供給減少解釋。但多個因素同時改變也可有相同結果，不能把單線解釋當成唯一原因。

A higher P with higher Q is consistent with a demand increase alone; higher P with lower Q fits a supply decrease alone. These patterns identify possible single-shift explanations, but simultaneous shifts may also generate them.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Truck price rises while sales fall. More expensive steel shifting supply left fits this pattern. 鋼材成本上升可解釋價升量跌。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Price falls and quantity rises. Which single shift fits? 價跌量升符合哪個單一移動？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
